import re
import sys

assignment = re.compile(
    r"(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:"
    r"(\d+)"
    r"|"
    r"\(\s*(a|b|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)"
    r")\s*;"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    target, literal, source, amount, modulus = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(amount)) % int(modulus)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
